tests.scope: CPU contracts, profiling payload identity / baseline selection / all-row failure gates, provenance, existing CUDA helpers and production vc24 helpers on SM86. No full Hopper attention execution.
tests.helper_result: Tested P bytes, maximum/alpha/mass/denominator/history match vc22 exactly. RNE boundary and random affine codes agree with old CUDA conversion and independent rounding of the FP32 FMA output.
tests.cases: 1/2/7/296 tiles; stable/rising/sparse maxima; lane-specific scales; nondefault stream; bounded affine / extreme fallback transitions; zero, tiny and threshold scales; half-integer ties and +/-8 adjacent FP32 values.

sm90a_cross_compile.bounded_encoding_path: 64 FFMA.SAT and 64 magic-bias FADD; no F2IP within bounded branch. Conversion fallback and tail remain in binary; static totals include untaken branches.
sm90a_cross_compile.scope: SASS instruction text comparison excludes encodings/control words. No new WGMMA group/order or shared memory changes.

h200_validation: Not run locally. Remote script validates before timing: 120 dtype/shape/algorithm cases repeated 3 times, 8 uniform-attention known answers and 32 fixed-payload maximum/scale cases for the new mode.
h200_performance: Unmeasured. Must improve same-run vc22_both full API. Moving work from conversion to FP32 arithmetic introduces extra additions and permutations, so no speedup or 22 ms claim.
